create_tensorboard_writer: create a TensorboardWriter instance with a log directory for tensorboard logging
create_wandb_writer: create a WeightsAndBiasesWriter instance with config to log metrics to wandb
get_writer_from_config: get a logging writer by config writer_type returning TensorboardWriter or WeightsAndBiasesWriter
add_video_from_np_images: add a video to tensorboard from a list of numpy array image frames
add_scalars_to_wandb: add multiple scalar metrics to wandb under a log group with step id
